name: bob-plugins
description: Official plugins for BoB Tools — Apps for Business: your team's data apps, currency rates, Telegram and Android control

plugins.name: bob-tools
plugins.description: BoB Tools — Apps for Business. Build and run your team's apps from your AI: tables, records, fields, views, dashboards, docs, share links and Telegram customer chats.

plugins.name: bob-currency
plugins.description: Access current and historical currency exchange rates for 140+ currencies. Works without sign-in; optional BoB account sign-in when the shared free limit is used up.

plugins.name: bob-chat
plugins.description: Connect Telegram to your AI: read, search and answer your own chats through the BoB Chat phone app. List chats, search contacts and messages, read unread and recent messages, send messages, mark chats read. Requires the BoB Chat app.

plugins.name: bob-control
plugins.description: Remote Android phone control via cloud relay — screenshots, UI tree, tap, swipe, type, app management, notifications. Runs on your phone; requires the BoB Control Android app.
